name: openjml
description: JML specification type-checking and static verification for Java via OpenJML

openjml.serverPath.description: Path to the openjml-lsp launcher script. Leave empty to use the script bundled with this extension (development) or the one found via the extension's default location.

openjml.checkTriggerOn.markdownDescription:
When to run the JML type-check (`--check`):
- `edit` — check on every change (instant feedback)
- `save` — check only when the file is saved

openjml.escTriggerOn.markdownDescription:
When to run extended static checking (`--esc`):
- `manual` — only via the **OpenJML: Run ESC** command or editor button
- `save` — on every save
- `edit` — on every change (expensive; not recommended for large files)

openjml.dirtyFileAction.markdownDescription:
What to do when ESC is invoked on a file with unsaved changes:
- `ask` — prompt each time
- `save` — always save the file first, silently
- `run` — always run ESC on the saved disk file without saving

openjml.propertiesFile.markdownDescription: Path to an OpenJML `.properties` file containing project-level options (prover, timeout, nullable-by-default, etc.). Leave empty to auto-discover `openjml.properties` in the workspace root. Options in this file are overridden by the settings below and by invocation-specific flags.

openjml.specsPath.description: Path to the OpenJML specs directory. Leave empty to use the default from the launcher script.

openjml.sourcePath.description: Source root(s) for resolving cross-file references (-sourcepath). Separate multiple roots with ':' (Unix) or ';' (Windows). Leave empty for single-file projects.

openjml.classPath.description: Classpath for pre-compiled dependencies (-classpath). Separate multiple entries with ':' (Unix) or ';' (Windows). Leave empty if no external jars are needed.

openjml.solversPath.description: Path to the SMT solvers directory. Leave empty to use the default from the launcher script.

openjml.escEngine.markdownDescription:
Which engine to use for ESC:
- `subprocess` (default) — spawns a fresh OpenJML process with `--esc`
- `concurrent` — calls `IAPI.doESC` in-process on the AST from the last successful `--check`; ESC attempts on methods are done concurrently according to the number of threads setting; no re-typechecking, faster per-method verification

openjml.escThreads.markdownDescription: Maximum number of concurrent ESC threads (**`concurrent` engine only** — ignored when `escEngine` is `subprocess`). Methods from different files are verified concurrently up to this limit; methods within the same file are serialized.

openjml.syntaxColoringStrategy.markdownDescription:
Strategy for JML syntax coloring:
- `regex` (default) — always uses regex (instant, but may color non-JML identifiers that happen to match JML keywords)
- `ast` — uses the attributed AST when available (precise, no false positives); falls back to regex before the first type-check

openjml.useIntegratedOutline.markdownDescription: When `true` (default), the Outline panel shows all Java and JML symbols together. When `false`, only JML-specific symbols (ghost, model) are shown, complementing the Red Hat Java extension's outline. Users can collapse irrelevant sections in either mode.

openjml.racOutputDir.description: Output directory for RAC-compiled class files (-d option). Relative paths are resolved against the workspace root. Leave empty to use 'rac-classes' in the workspace root.
